lessons_stated.value: Wait for the higher-timeframe (5m) retrace before entering, rather than chasing a 1m entry. Entering without the retrace gets you stopped out more often, and it is fine not to catch every trade.
lessons_stated.ref: [05:30] 'i wanna see some higher time [frame] retraces'; [06:00]-[06:15] 'we [wait for the] retrace ... much rather wait [for the] retrace rather than ... trying to enter'; [06:45] 'you're going to [get] stop[ped] a lot more'; [07:00] 'not catch every single ... trade'. My paraphrase of fragments.

lessons_stated.value: His model: a liquidity sweep at the open plus SMT, then a break of structure nearby, then a retrace, then continuation toward the draw on liquidity.
lessons_stated.ref: [08:15]-[08:30] 'this is like TJR strategy ... liquidity sweep on top of that there is a [SMT] ... [break] of structure nearby ... retraces ... continuation'. Garbled.

lessons_stated.value: Be careful in a heavy news week (FOMC minutes, Jackson Hole, Powell on Friday); price can move slowly until the news.
If the setup doesn't come, don't trade: no trade today.
